feeds.title: The Malibu Times
feeds.description: The Malibu Times was established in 1946 by Reeves Templeman and William Macfadyen. The Times remains committed to providing thousands of Malibu locals and millions of Malibu visitors the news and information they want and need to make the most of their Malibu lifestyle and experience.

feeds.title: Cliffside Malibu Blog
feeds.description: At Cliffside Malibu, we've managed to create an exclusive sanctuary for individuals recovering from a drug or alcohol addiction by limiting our enrollment and offering a myriad of cutting-edge treatments. Our state-of-the-art treatment methods are also paired with the talents of acupuncturists, massage therapists, holistic medicine practitioners, Reiki practitioners, and Breathworks specialists.

feeds.title: Avalon Malibu Blog
feeds.description: Avalon Malibu Mental Health & Addiction Treatment Center is a California state-licensed residential addiction and mental health treatment center dedicated to the healing of adults experiencing substance abuse disorders as well as psychiatric and mental health issues. Utilizing experiential methodologies, expressive arts, and research-based psychotherapies, we offer both a holistic residential drug rehabilitation center as well as a residential mental health treatment center.

feeds.title: Malibu Apothecary Blog
feeds.description: Your one-stop destination for the best destination-inspired candles, DIYs like how to repurpose your candle jars, info on clean candles, wellness, travel, and more! Malibu Apothecary was inspired by Founder Claire Ellis's love for travel, wellness, and all things luxury. Malibu Apothecary crafts olfactory experiences through their transportive fragrances that capture Claire's cultivated passion for travel and clean, non-toxic living.

feeds.title: Seasons In Malibu Blog
feeds.description: Latest posts and articles about drug rehab, addiction recovery, treatment programs, and more. Stay updated on our field and services here. We are a California State licensed, CARF accredited, world-class treatment center, licensed in both substance abuse and mental health, celebrating over 12 years of service.

feeds.title: Passages Malibu
feeds.description: Passages is the industry leader in holistic non-12 Step addiction treatment. We have been treating people since 2001. Our team of professionals is highly trained in their prospective fields and constantly strives to offer the most innovative and effective therapy possible. We offer detox, residential treatment, and outpatient services. Discover more about addiction and recovery tips, solutions and more from our experts.

feeds.title: The Local Malibu
feeds.description: The Local Malibu is an activist/truth-seeking platform reporting on major news stories important to the Malibu Community and surrounding areas. Our mission is to inform, educate, inspire, and entertain like-minded people - people who, like us, are passionately curious, authentic, and motivated to make an impact in society.

feeds.title: Malibu Race Series Blog
feeds.description: The Malibu Half Marathon & 5K Blog features both original contents as well as posts from our favorite fitness bloggers and publications. Sold-Out Event for the last 4 years, Run Malibu presented by Rusnak BMW is excited to welcome runners and walkers from around the country to Malibu.

feeds.title: LifeSync Malibu Detox
feeds.description: LifeSync Malibu Healing Center was created by Dr. Geoffrey A. Booth, M.D. so that people with substance use and alcoholism can come and receive the best available treatment anywhere. The whole program has been developed and structured to ensure that you will receive all the necessary tools and interventions to get sober and stay sober.

feeds.title: Veronica Malibu
feeds.description: Veronica Barton-Schwartz is one of the leading experts in skincare in Los Angeles. She incorporates the newest advanced technologies and treatments with a holistic approach to achieving a healthy lifestyle at her Skin and Body Care Center in Malibu, California. At her exclusive seaside retreat, she offers everything from luxurious facials, and body treatments to lasers and injectibles to yoga and private sessions with a Tai Chi Master.

feeds.title: CrossFit Malibu Blog
feeds.description: CrossFit Malibu is a group CrossFit and Personal Training Center in the heart of Malibu. CrossFit Malibu redefines what you think is possible for your fitness. We have been training local Malibu clients for over a decade. From World Record-holding athletes to 84-year-olds, we help all fitness levels and ages. Avid surfers, CEOs, and students have found extra energy to thrive in their everyday lives.

feeds.title: Malibu Daily News
feeds.description: Malibu Daily News brings you the local Malibu news. Stay tuned to read the latest breaking news, headlines, reports, local news, and more.

feeds.title: Glamifornia Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Glamifornia blog, a place where you can learn all about the latest trends and news in beauty and wellness, art and fashion (the Glamifornia mantra), and all things glam. Features the latest sessions held at the Glamifornia Style Lounge (GSL), press features, DIY tips and tricks, and much more.

feeds.title: Malibu Gift Blog
feeds.description: Read our Malibu Gift blog your online source for healthy food gifts for birthdays, anniversaries, baby showers, special holidays and more. MalibuGift offers a carefully curated and delicious catalog of high-end gourmet food gifts and accoutrements that are sourced from our favorite location, Malibu

feeds.title: The Pointe Malibu Recovery Center Blog
feeds.description: The Pointe Malibu Recovery Center is dedicated to providing clients and their families with unsurpassed, world-class medical and clinical treatment services for drug and alcohol addiction, process addictions, mental health issues, co-occurring disorders, and chronic pain.

feeds.title: The Meadows Malibu
feeds.description: Read articles and information about the latest on drug and alcohol addiction, ways to maintain sobriety, and mental health. The Meadows Malibu is an exclusive, boutique-style residential treatment program addressing substance abuse and mental health issues in a private, serene setting in the heart of coastal Malibu, California.

feeds.title: Heather Gardner Blog
feeds.description: Native Californian and Malibu resident Heather Gardner started her jewelry business without any formal training in the summer of 2006. California's diverse landscape of endless coastlines, hidden dramatic canyons, and mountainous regions, have provided ample opportunities for Gardner to explore and take pleasure in. As a global traveler and outdoor adventurer, she seeks to capture the essence of the world's beauty in her designs as well as the essence of earth, femininity, and fashion.

feeds.title: Malibu Beach Inn Hotel Blog
feeds.description: Read the Malibu Beach Inn Hotel Blog to find out more about the stay, offers, best places, and more. The Malibu Beach Inn is a luxury oceanfront hotel offering elegantly-appointed guestrooms, onsite dining, and spa suite services. Located on Malibu's Carbon Beach.

feeds.title: The Mark & Grether Group Blog
feeds.description: Get Malibu real estate news, luxury realty news, Malibu real estate listings, Malibu real estate agents, and more from the Malibu Luxury Real Estate Blog. Combining the talents of Tony Mark and Russell Grether, two top-producing agents, The Mark & Grether Group brings together local expertise, comprehensive experience, and unparalleled results in a singular team.

feeds.title: Serenity Malibu Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest news in drug and alcohol addiction treatment research, headlines, and other topics. Serenity Malibu evolved from the vision and desire to help people struggling with alcoholism and addiction, and at the same time actually improve the quality of addiction treatment resources for everyone.

feeds.title: Inspire Malibu Blog
feeds.description: Inspire Malibu is the premier Non 12 Step, drug, alcohol, and detox treatment center in Malibu California. Inspire Malibu's state-of-the-art treatment program combines the latest scientific research with proven, evidence-based therapies to address both alcohol and substance abuse successfully.
